facts.fact: Captain Muthu was Devan's kalari partner before Devan stopped sparring eight years ago, and he asks for a round every seventh day.
facts.why: needed because Janu says Devan 'used to have a partner' (F047) and the beat requires Muthu to beg weekly, which makes his hurt specific.

facts.fact: Kannan's mother is named Bindu and sings; Neela learned this from women at the well.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Neela to know the goat-boy's mother's name.

facts.fact: Neela's cover guardian is Kunjan Chirayil, who kept the Chirayil north warehouse in Kodiyur.
facts.why: needed because Devan tests her cover with a personal detail from the council papers.

facts.fact: Asha came to the fort at nineteen and in her first month wrote every recruit's name and mother's village on a slate.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Devan to remember Asha learning every recruit's name.

facts.fact: The sentry Devan has pulled off the rampart is the one above the warden's window (ch 4 placement), not below it as the outline says; Devan lifts the shutter bar and leaves it against the wall that night.
facts.why: needed because chapter 4 placed the sentry above the window, so the outline's 'below' was reconciled to canon.
